name: Popover / Header
summary: Popover heading group containing Title and Description.
description: Popover heading group containing Title and Description. Both text nodes are editable component properties and should be associated with the popup for accessible naming and description.
dos: Compose it through the parent rather than reaching for it directly.
donts: Do not re-implement the parent's keyboard or focus behaviour on the part.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
